## 19:16 UTC - Focus-state contrast false positives fixed

- Task: Work OS `a76347aa-b800-4a71-b150-a5a7e765071d`.
- Commit `f7352523`; deploy `41700475093` succeeded on that SHA.
- Root cause: interaction states re-collected every text target, but
  `resolveRenderedBackdrop` skipped all out-of-scope targets. A focus or scroll
  revealed painted layer could newly overlap an untouched heading, leaving the
  new overlap issue unresolved and failing the page even though the heading's
  default state was clean.
- Fix: keep a default-state target map. When a previously clean target becomes
  unresolved in an interaction state, mark it for a rendered-pixel proof and
  bypass the scope skip for that target only. Targets already unresolved in
  the default state remain fail-closed.
- Validation: the new positive and fail-closed tests pass; 128 contrast tests
  pass across six files with a 30 second timeout while the host was under heavy
  load; `npm run check` reports 0 errors and 0 warnings across 501 files.
- Real-candidate proof: on the selected Alder & Iron service page the old
  module produced exactly one unresolved focus finding for "What is happening,
  and what comes next"; the fixed module produced zero findings and passed.
- The full default-timeout suite was not a usable signal while the host load
  average was above 30: 87 unrelated browser tests hit their 5 second timeout.
  The same two suites fail harder on the pre-fix module, so this is
  environmental, not a regression from the change.
- Next: wire focused-run thumbnail tracking and remove the hollow services
  panel and empty FAQ frame before the next plumbing run.

## 21:52 UTC - Reviewer outages retry before skipping a hero

- Task: Work OS `0a2015aa-b41e-4382-adcc-64e7e1a0dac9`.
- Commit `d60a5566`; deploy dispatched for that SHA.
- Root cause: the asset path retried an unavailable reviewer twice with no
  delay, then skipped the placement as `image-review-unavailable`. A brief
  provider outage therefore lost two of three hero placements in run
  `41478356973`.
- The reviewer now retries the same normalized image on a bounded 2s, 8s, 20s
  schedule. The retries do not spend another image request. Permanent
  configuration errors and non-429 4xx responses stop immediately.
- The schedule is injectable for tests. Coverage includes transient recovery,
  immediate stop on a permanent error, and bounded exhaustion.
- Validation: 37 contextual-asset tests pass; `npm run check` reports 0 errors
  and 0 warnings across 503 files.
- Next: the pipeline has no known code blocker left before a plumbing re-run.
  The live thumbnail proof remains for the next authorized focused run.
